Before adverting to the facts of the present petition for deciding the above issue, at the very outset, it would be apposite to note here that strict rules of evidence are not applicable in an inquiry conducted by Motor Accident Claims Tribunal.
The standard of proof is not as strict as in criminal cases and evidence is to be tested on the touchstone of preponderance of probabilities only.

In fact,
the burden of proof in a claim petition under the M.V. Act, is even lesser than a civil case.
Reference in this regard can be made to the proposition of law laid down by the Hon'ble Supreme Court of India in case of "Bimla Devi and others Vs. Himachal Road Transport Corporation and Ors."
